verdict.rationale: The evidence never mentions handwriting recognition. The closest support is Track Changes, which extracts redlines and comments from PDFs and scans, plus schema-based field extraction with bounding-box citations; together these only glancingly touch extracting annotations and fields from scanned documents. Missing for 10: explicit handwritten text and field recognition, confidence scores or uncertainty flags on extracted values, documentation of handwritten annotation handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration on handwritten inputs.
